hooks.command: payload=$(cat); tp=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.transcript_path // ""'); case "$tp" in */subagents/*) printf 'SKIP(subagent) %s\n' "$tp" >> /tmp/claude-stop-debug.log; exit 0;; esac; cwd=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.cwd // "unknown"'); printf 'NOTIFY %s\n' "$tp" >> /tmp/claude-stop-debug.log; curl -s -X POST "https://api.telegram.org/bot${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage" --data-urlencode "chat_id=${TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}" --data-urlencode "text=Claude Code done — $(basename "$cwd")" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

payload=$(cat); ntype=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.notification_type // "?"'); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.cwd // "unknown"'); msg=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.message // ""'); printf 'NOTIF type=%s cwd=%s msg=%s\n' "$ntype" "$cwd" "$msg" >> /tmp/claude-notify-debug.log; curl -s -X POST "https://api.telegram.org/bot${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage" --data-urlencode "chat_id=${TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}" --data-urlencode "text=Claude Code [$ntype] — $(basename "$cwd")" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
